scripts.audit: node --check src/app.js && for f in src/features/*.js workers/*.js sw.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node tests/undef-check.cjs src/ai/*.js src/ui/*.js src/studio/*.js src/github/*.js src/media/*.js src/team/*.js src/perf/*.js && echo '✅ JS syntax OK'
